entries.heading: For all of the funds appropriated
ancestors: DIVISION B—EMERGENCY APPROPRIATIONS FOR CORONAVIRUS HEALTH RESPONSE AND AGENCY OPERATIONS
entries.text:
Sec. 20002.  For all of the funds appropriated 
in this title the Secretary of Veterans Affairs shall submit to the 
Committees on Appropriations of both Houses of Congress monthly reports 
detailing obligations, expenditures, and planned activities.
